description: This file defines the AzureQueueOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for an Azure Queue Stream provider in Orleans. It includes properties and methods for setting up and validating Azure Queue service clients, such as configuring with connection strings, service URIs, credentials, and managing queue names and message visibility timeouts.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for Azure Queue Stream provider, including client options, client creation delegates, queue names, and message timeout.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates AzureQueueOptions configuration, ensuring necessary credentials and queue names are set.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueServiceClient
methods.description: Various overloads to configure the QueueServiceClient using connection strings, URIs, credentials, or callback functions.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks whether the configuration has valid credentials and queue names.
